split_rules: Assign complete independent scenes before creating node views, channel realizations, retransmission traces, or semantic granularities.
Keep every derivative of one scene in exactly one split.
Use train truth for model and counterfactual-value fitting only.
Use calibration only for confidence and quality calibration.
Use validation for thresholds, hyperparameters, ablations, and decision gates.
Run final_holdout once only after code, weights, budgets, thresholds, and success rules are frozen.
Do not reuse any consumed stage-3 holdout as the stage-4 final holdout.
Do not count reporting-link repeats as independent RF scenes.

available_sources.reason: Synthetic radar frames and all existing directory splits have already been used in stages 1-3; correlated node views remain controlled diagnostics.
Only two independent RF events and a saturated resource-selection task.

claim_boundary: This registry freezes the protocol without inventing scene IDs. Until materialized from a new independent catalog, it supports implementation and diagnostics only, not a final H2/H3 claim.
